item.text: The three controls currently manage progress separately, and Kick/Ban only mark themselves busy after confirmation. I’m moving the lock to `RoomAdminToolsContainer`, with a synchronous ref guard so a second activation is rejected before React redraws, and I’ll keep each button usable in its existing standalone tests.

The shared lock now starts synchronously before confirmation, spans all three controls for that member, and releases on cancellation or when the request settles. I’m formatting the edits and checking the component’s existing Jest coverage plus type/lint diagnostics.
Formatting completed. The focused Jest run is still in progress; once it finishes I’ll address any failures and inspect the final diff for state-release or accessibility issues.

item.text:
Implemented a member-scoped pending lock for Kick, Ban/Unban, and Mute/Unmute in [UserInfo.tsx](/app/src/components/views/right_panel/UserInfo.tsx). It blocks rapid activations synchronously, sets both `disabled` and `aria-disabled`, and releases on confirmation cancellation or when the operation settles. Existing failure dialogs remain in place.

The focused suite passed: **68 tests**. ESLint and `git diff --check` passed. `yarn lint:types` reported errors in dependencies and unrelated SDK/application files; it reported none in `UserInfo.tsx`.
